newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai economy grows 12.3 pct in Jan-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai economy grows 12.3 pct in Jan-Feb.

text.p: Shanghai's economy grew 12.3 percent in the first two months of this year with Gross Domestic Product surpassing 43 billion yuan for China's commercial hub, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.

In January and February, the city generated 72.6 billion yuan in industrial output value, up 12.8 percent compared with the year-ago period, it said quoting figures from the Shanghai Municipal Statistics Bureau.
Exports exceeded $2.0 billion during the two months, up more than 10 percent from a year ago, it said.
Local retail sales of consumer goods hit a record of nearly 22.9 billion yuan in the first two months, a 16.5 percent of rise compared with the same period of the previous year.
Retail prices rose 0.9 percent, down by 6.4 percentage points compared with the year-ago period, it said.
Shanghai is targeting economic growth of 10 percent this year.
